name: Tami Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: Gri

sections.description:
You can receive payments for your WooCommerce store using the Tami payment method.
To modify/develop credit card form: https://bitbucket.org/grilabs/tami-credit-card-page (VueJS project)
When you activated the test mode option, you will perform transactions on https://sandbox-paymentapi.tami.com.tr and https://sandbox-portal.tami.com.tr servers.
When the test environment option is not active, you will perform transactions on https://paymentapi.tami.com.tr and https://portal.tami.com.tr servers.

About data policy

This plugin combines the your TAMI store information (merchant id, terminal id, api secret key) you have entered and the card information that users will enter with the personal information(order details) provided by the user during their order and sends it to the TAMI services when payment is made.
You may be responsible for the data transfer here within the framework of the agreements between you and TAMI.
TAMI’s agreements should also be taken into account when using the add-on. You have already approved the relevant agreements when opening an account with TAMI.
The plugin does not communicate with any other external source.
– https://www.tami.com.tr/kullanim-kosullari-ve-gizlilik-politikasi
– https://www.tami.com.tr/kisisel-verilerin-korunmasi
– https://www.tami.com.tr/cerez-politikasi

Some of the benefits it will provide you:

  • Payment methods you can use: 3D, Non-Secure, Hosted Payment Page
  • You can receive payment in installments
  • Cancellation, refund, partial refund support
  • Special control panel for the plugin
  • Open and close installment payments
  • Set a lower limit for installment payments
  • Log all transactions with debug mode
  • Log failed payment requests in order notes
  • Set a status for order status update after payment
  • Test environment (sandbox) support
sections.faq:
How do I create a Tami account?

You can start your with immediately by visiting Tami: https://tami.com.tr/
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • This is the launch version. No changes yet.

1.0.1

  • A small syntax bug fixed.

1.1

  • API V3 support added.
  • Nonce verification in the callback step was causing problems. Removed.
  • Fixed some display problems.

1.2

  • Plugin tags updated for WordPress market warnings.
